T-1.5.8 exists because T-1.5.2 removed five wire actions and two callers
survived - one inside a string constant in runtime_bundle.py, one inside
a CI workflow - invisible for weeks because nothing enumerated the
callers of a removed surface. A one-time census finds those once; this
file is what makes it standing.
A D4 census task that deletes a public surface appends its names here in
the same commit. The check is
Occurrences inside a negative assertion - a test proving the surface is
gone - are not violations; the checker recognises them, so the tests that
prove a removal do not have to be exempted one by one.
